---
commit 25dc0ea8ad1f0d6cfae9772c8af5ed1b9414695c
Author: robinhultman <robin.hultman@integrio.se>
Date:   Thu Aug 6 12:54:55 2026 +0200

    feat(topology)!: track Intropy.Topology 0.4.0 — name-only connectors, no schedules
    
    Intropy.Topology 0.4.0 carries only minted facts (ADR 0010): the graph
    JSON no longer emits a transport object on connectors, and the schedule
    left the model with WithSchedule. The CLI's consumer side follows.
    
    - internal/topology: Transport, Connector.Transport and
      Connector.DeployedTransport are deleted. The name is the connector's
      whole identity; the deployed Dapr binding type, address, and
      credentials are environment-owned deployment configuration.
    - internal/deploy: InitConnector drops Transport; the injected
      .topology model a deploy-host skeleton ranges over carries name,
      externalSystem, directions and appIds only.
    - The integration test asserts the rendered binding is a REPLACE-ME
      scaffold with minted name and scopes and no pre-chosen spec.type.
    - sys create goldens drop extractorSchedule, .WithSchedule and
      Transport.Default() to mirror the system-host template's 0.4.0
      render.
    
    BREAKING CHANGE: topology records from hosts built on Intropy.Topology
    0.3.x are no longer decoded into transports; pair this CLI with
    0.4.0-tracking template releases.
    
    Entire-Checkpoint: 1c4e66342b7f
